as_told.place_text: F.E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a 2010 event at F.E. Warren Air Force Base in Wyoming, a base that controls nuclear missiles, where he says key staff reported several separate UFO sightings at the same time as a power failure. He credits the researcher Robert Hastings and a Wired magazine article, and in one telling says people on site, through back channels, describe a white oval object shaped like a Tic Tac mint flying around, pairing it with a 1967 case at another missile base, Malmstrom. If true, it would mean unknown craft are taking an interest in nuclear weapons.
